scope: Sole enumerated Irudad Face/0 fit uses corrected v2 softly oval reading lenses, fine wire, distinct bridge and original-head rear occlusion. User-rejected v1 remains historical. No mutation-body or native outfit acceptance claimed.

authoring_review.reason: User rejected v1 pointed/goggle-like front and floating rear hook. Inspected corrected v2 ordinary reading spectacles: softly oval transparent lenses, fine wire rims, visibly separate arched bridge, plain ear temples and rounded edge-on profile lens just ahead of the face. The original head/ears conceal the complete rear frame, with no external arc or lens. Actual original body remains unchanged. Reviewed source/mod/construction/current comparison, neutral and native y/Y palette, full item before rear mask and intended-size views. This is an authoring selection, not user/native acceptance or completion of Irudad mutations/outfit.
